printed_source_discrepancies.issue: Printed sample MODA3p-12.2.8 despite 6U row and earlier §13.3.3 u=6 for 6U; no guessed correction.
Printed RF1 RF design suffix is not independently defined by earlier C239 Table13.3.2-2 RF0/RFx; later §13.3.8 original unreviewed.
Printed 4A2F lacks verified source definition in earlier C239 50-entry dictionary; no inventing token semantics.
Source *-Legacy flags attached to selected profile dash options, not entire card families or current equipment.
Dense matrix source row labels and protocol tokens can be read, but exact X/unused/allowed cell coordinate alignment not independently visually audited.

exact_holds.reason: Original §13.3.4 dense multi-column rows available in extracted inline text, but exact column/cell visual alignment and complete per-port matrix audit were not independently verified; page-image retrieval failed.
